title: Mobile Mega Menu - Category Nodes Compact
summary: Mobile off-canvas navigation with category grid and hierarchical menus.
features: Category grid layout using compact node components
Hierarchical navigation between root and child menus
User login button in sticky header
Free content slots for CTA banners or additional nodes
longDescription:
## Purpose

The MegaMenuMobile component provides mobile shoppers with a touch-optimized, full-screen navigation experience. It presents the store's category structure in a visually scannable compact grid format within an off-canvas sheet overlay.

## Use Cases

- **Category Browsing**: Users tap category nodes in a compact grid to explore the first navigation level. Selecting a category transitions to a child menu showing subcategories.
- **Account Access**: A sticky header with login button provides quick access to user account functionality relocated from the desktop header.
- **Promotional Content**: Free content slots accept CMS-managed content like CTA banners or additional category grids, enabling marketing placement within the menu.
- **Site Preferences**: Language/locale switching and dark mode toggle (moved from desktop top bar) are accessible within the mobile menu.

## Design Rationale

The component splits into three sub-components: MegaMenuMobile (wrapper with sheet and login), RootMenu (main category grid), and ChildMenu (subcategory view). The off-canvas sheet uses a max-width of 400px with responsive padding for smaller screens. Content slots remain empty when unfilled to avoid visual clutter.
